question: Show violation counts by type for the last 6 months.
text: Over the past 6 months, the most common violation types reported were Droppings / insects / pest damage (375 reports), Water damage / suspected mold (322), and Holes, peeling paint, damaged flooring (311). Less frequent violations included No heat (user-reported / temp evidence) (56) and Blocked exit / unsafe stairs / missing handrail (64). The data shows that pest and water-related issues are the most prevalent concerns among reported violations.
sql:
SELECT vt.name AS violation_type, COUNT(*) AS violation_count
FROM fixit.gold.reports r
JOIN fixit.ref.violation_types vt ON r.violation_type = vt.type_id
WHERE r.reported_at >= dateadd(MONTH, -6, CURRENT_DATE)
  AND r.reported_at IS NOT NULL
  AND r.violation_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY vt.name
ORDER BY violation_count DESC
